currentState: Working courtesy at the hatch: Neral takes Jaina's help for the cellar read, catches the water skin the mage's hand drops, tips her head at the mage to take the child's answer about the sweetness. They do not address each other by name or title on page; Neral leaves for the Pass at first light with no farewell shown between them.
powerDynamic: Neral leads with the girl; Jaina asks short questions through and around her ('Was it before she was ill?') and defers to Neral's handling.

physicalDynamics.pattern: Passes behind Jaina's horse, tugs the girth hard once, says 'My lady'; takes the horses upwind while Jaina is in the ditch.
Chapter 3: Neral takes the water skin out of the air under the mage's failing hand; tips her head at the mage to indicate the girl may answer her; Jaina's voice drops to match Neral's low register.

nameUsage.neralCallsJaina: 'My lady' (Ch2); 'a lady with a stick' (to the girl, Ch3); no direct address.

history.event: Neral checks Jaina's tack at the Pass; Jaina reads the cut on the grey's near hock for contamination (clean).
Chapter 3: Neral and Jaina work the cellar and the girl's testimony together; Jaina rechecks the grey, whose tooth-score is scabbed black, still clean.

trajectory: Neral leaves the book's southbound party at the end of Chapter 3.
